title: AgenticDeveloperIdentity
description: Developer identity configuration for Supervised Autonomous Development Coordination.

schema_version.description: Schema version number for backwards compatibility.

display_name.description: Human developer display name (e.g. Alice Smith).

github_username.description: GitHub username matching the active gh CLI session.

machine_label.description: Identifier for the local workstation/laptop (e.g. dev-laptop-arch).

preferred_editor.description: Optional preferred editor or IDE (e.g. code, cursor, nvim).

project_number.description: GitHub Project v2 number if bound.

project_owner.description: GitHub Project v2 owner organization or user login.

status_field.description: Name of the status field in GitHub Projects (default: Status).

priority_field.description: Name of the priority field in GitHub Projects (default: Priority).
